Fonts and Sizes
Each line below is set in a different font family:
This line is set in Helvetica Neue.  (a sans-serif)
This line is set in Times New Roman.  (a serif)
This line is set in Georgia.  (another serif)
This line is set in Arial.  (a common sans-serif)
This line is set in Courier New.  (a monospace)
This line is set in Menlo.  (another monospace)
This line is set in Comic Sans MS.  (an informal face)
A range of point sizes on one line:
8pt 11pt 14pt 18pt 24pt 36pt 48pt 
Regular, bold, italic, and bold italic in the body font.
A run requesting a font that is probably not installed, to capture how Pages substitutes:
This text asks for the font Nonexistent Sans.
